title: MUBEN: a bilingual brand site with SvelteKit, Go and embedded SQLite
excerpt: How I built a minimal, Japanese-inspired fashion brand site: a SvelteKit public site and admin CMS, a Go/Fiber API, and a SQLite file in place of a database server.
